clue.text: 1 in 7 is not happy

definitions.meaning: first meaning: one of the Seven Dwarfs in Snow White

explanation.walkthrough: The joke is that Happy is also one of the Seven Dwarfs, so this one is pointedly not him.
explanation.definitionFit: The dwarf's name is also the everyday adjective for someone irritable and sullen.

clue.text: My muck sends off courteous setter

parts.note: goo is sticky muck

indicators.note: something gone off is spoiled, so the letters of sends are rearranged

parts.note: taken as written, the letters to be rearranged
gracious means polite and kind
the setter refers to themself as me

explanation.surface: Someone appalled that the filth has sent away a polite crossword setter.
explanation.walkthrough: 'My' looks like a possessive but is the exclamation of surprise.
explanation.definitionFit: Both are dated interjections expressing surprise or mild shock.

clue.text: Channel says you are heartbroken

indicators.note: says signals that the letters are chosen to sound like the words you are

parts.note: the letters U and R spoken aloud sound like these two words
read as heart broken: the letters of heart are broken up and rearranged

explanation.surface: A TV channel announcing that the viewer is grief-stricken.
explanation.walkthrough: The anagram fodder is hiding inside the single word heartbroken.
explanation.definitionFit: The urethra is the duct that carries urine out of the body, a channel in the anatomical sense.

clue.text: This philosophy gives patriarchal extremists a boost

indicators.note: the extremists of a word are its outermost letters, here of patriarchal

parts.note: only the outer letters of this word are used
taken as written
a tonic is a pick-me-up

explanation.surface: Claims that a certain philosophy encourages hardline patriarchs.
explanation.definitionFit: Platonic describes the philosophy of Plato and his followers.

clue.text: Bad luck? Slap this on your head

definitions.text: Bad luck? Slap this on your head

indicators.note: bad suggests the letters of luck slap are in a poor, jumbled state

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: A superstitious remedy: if luck is against you, cover your head.
explanation.definitionFit: A skullcap is a small close-fitting cap worn on the crown of the head.

clue.text: Need to take things like a man? Opt out!

indicators.note: out implies the letters are put out of their usual order

parts.note: taken as written, part of the letters to be rearranged
taken as written, the rest of the letters to be rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone told to opt out if they feel a manly urge to grab things.
explanation.definitionFit: Kleptomania is a compulsive urge to steal, regardless of need.

clue.text: Unclaimed billions brought up to frame politician

indicators.note: in a down clue, brought up means the letters are read from bottom to top
the words unclaimed billions frame the letters we want, which sit across the word break

parts.note: the run of letters straddling these two words

explanation.surface: Billions of unclaimed money used to set up a politician.
explanation.walkthrough: A Lib Dem is a member of the Liberal Democrats, a British political party.
explanation.definitionFit: Lib Dem is the short name for a member of the UK's Liberal Democrat party, a politician.

clue.text: Underwear turned up in search for explosive

indicators.note: in places one piece inside the other

parts.note: to comb an area is to search it thoroughly

indicators.note: in a down clue, turned up means read from bottom to top

parts.note: a bra is an item of underwear

explanation.surface: Underwear found during a search for explosives.
explanation.definitionFit: A car bomb is an explosive device hidden in a vehicle.

clue.text: Dance when 17, confused about debutante's first kiss

indicators.note: about wraps the jumbled letters around the debutante's initial
confused shows the letters of that answer are mixed up

parts.note: the answer to 17 down

indicators.note: first takes just the opening letter of debutante's

parts.note: only the initial of this word is used
X is the kiss at the end of a letter

explanation.surface: A debutante, nervous at a ball, gets confused about her first kiss.
explanation.definitionFit: A pas de deux is a ballet dance for two performers.

clue.text: We stay on plan to protect green growth — no turning back here

indicators.note: to protect is to surround, so the tree sits inside
a plan arranges things, so the letters of we stay on are arranged afresh

parts.note: taken as written, the letters to be rearranged
a tree is a green growing thing

explanation.surface: Environmental campaigners staying put to protect trees, with no backing down.
explanation.walkthrough: 'No turning back' sounds like resolve but describes traffic that may only go one way.
explanation.definitionFit: On a one-way street traffic may only travel in one direction, so you cannot turn round.

clue.text: Monster like Radovan Karadžic sounding certain to make a comeback

indicators.note: sounding means we want the spoken sound of that word, spelt differently

parts.note: Karadžić was a Bosnian Serb leader

indicators.note: making a comeback, the word goes back the way it came

parts.note: sure means certain

explanation.surface: Calling a notorious war criminal a monster.
explanation.definitionFit: Cerberus is the three-headed dog guarding the underworld in Greek myth.

clue.text: So take a breath and pay?

definitions.meaning: first meaning: one way to inhale, with so meaning in this way
second meaning: to pay far too much

explanation.walkthrough: The question mark flags that 'pay' only works as part of the idiom paying through the nose.
explanation.definitionFit: Air is inhaled via the nostrils; the idiom for being overcharged uses the same phrase.

clue.text: Burn smog, OK with energy

definitions.meaning: the definition: to be consumed by fire
a reverse clue: the answer read as instructions, GO turned up inside SMOK, plus E for energy, builds these letters

explanation.surface: An instruction to burn off the smog, which is fine since it yields energy.
explanation.walkthrough: This is a reverse clue: follow the answer as wordplay (a word read upwards placed in a fragment, then E) and you get smog, OK with energy.
explanation.definitionFit: To go up in smoke is to burn away completely, or figuratively to come to nothing.

clue.text: See 1 down
Progressive finished university

explanation.walkthrough: 'Progressive' tempts a political reading; it means increasing by steps, as in graduated tax.
explanation.definitionFit: Graduated describes something rising in steps, and is also the past tense for completing a degree course.

clue.text: See 16
Fancy stereo discs occasionally used for the select few

indicators.note: fancy as a verb means imagine, so the letters of stereo are reimagined

parts.note: taken as written, the letters to be rearranged

indicators.note: occasionally takes only some letters of discs, every other one

parts.note: alternate letters of this word

explanation.surface: Fancy stereo equipment that only a few audiophiles would appreciate.
explanation.definitionFit: Esoteric knowledge is intended for or understood by only a small inner circle.

clue.text: Allow mother to have a turn first, being cooperative

indicators.note: first tells us this reversed piece leads the answer
having a turn, the word is turned round

parts.note: ma is mother
to enable is to allow

explanation.surface: Letting mother go first is the cooperative thing to do.
explanation.definitionFit: An amenable person is willing to go along with requests, agreeable.

clue.text: After 50% increase, party slackened

indicators.note: after fifty per cent means only the latter half of the word increase is kept

parts.note: the word whose second half is kept
the DUP is the Democratic Unionist Party of Northern Ireland

explanation.surface: A party relaxing its stance after a fifty per cent rise.
explanation.walkthrough: The DUP is a Northern Irish political party.
explanation.definitionFit: To ease up is to relax or reduce effort, so slackened is the past tense.

clue.text: Other set wins fight in court?

definitions.note: a definition by description: the thing found in a court of law

indicators.note: other means different, so the letters of set wins take a different order

parts.note: taken as written, the letters to be rearranged
to box is to fight with fists

explanation.surface: A tennis match where the other set is won in a fight on court.
explanation.walkthrough: The court sounds like tennis, with sets and wins, but it is a law court.
explanation.definitionFit: The witness box is the enclosure in a courtroom where people give evidence.

clue.text: During time of economic prosperity, socialist having little to do?

definitions.note: describes the state, a noun, by its cause

indicators.note: during places the second piece within the period

parts.note: a boom is a period of growth
red is the colour of the left

explanation.surface: A socialist idling during an economic boom.
explanation.definitionFit: Boredom is the weariness that comes from lacking anything interesting to occupy you.

clue.text: See 9
Perhaps Austin's plant is not good enough

indicators.note: perhaps suggests the letters might be arranged some other way

parts.note: taken as written, the letters to be rearranged
a plant is an industrial works

explanation.surface: A judgement on the old Austin car works.
explanation.walkthrough: Austin was a British car maker, which makes 'plant' look like its factory.
explanation.definitionFit: Unsatisfactory means failing to meet the required standard.

clue.text: See 1
Excellent foot soldiers manoeuvring without loss

indicators.note: manoeuvring soldiers are moved about, so these letters are rearranged
without means the letters of loss are taken away

parts.note: taken as written; the letters of loss come out of it, then the rest is rearranged

explanation.surface: Infantry on manoeuvres suffering no casualties, a fine result.
explanation.walkthrough: The letters of loss are taken out of foot soldiers in two runs, SOL and a final S.
explanation.definitionFit: Something to die for is so desirable as to be superb.

clue.text: Game of golf hosted by newlywed

indicators.note: hosted by means the second piece is held within the first

parts.note: a bride has just married
G is golf in the NATO phonetic alphabet

explanation.surface: A newlywed hosting a round of golf.
explanation.definitionFit: Bridge is a card game for four players in partnerships.

clue.text: Elected president starts probing work assistants

indicators.note: probing pushes these letters into the other word

parts.note: duties are the tasks of a job

indicators.note: the starts of elected president are their first letters

parts.note: the first letters of these two words

explanation.surface: A newly elected president begins to investigate the work of their staff.
explanation.definitionFit: Deputies are people appointed to act for or help a superior.

clue.text: Troublemakers temporarily live on board

parts.note: SS, a steamship, stands round the other letters as a ship holds passengers on board
to camp is to stay somewhere temporarily

explanation.surface: Mischief-makers staying for a while on a ship.
explanation.definitionFit: Scamps are mischievous rascals, often children.
